name: Unusual Sequences
description: Count the number of distinct sequences a 1 , a 2 , ..., a n ( 1 ≤ a i ) consisting of positive integers such that gcd ( a 1 , a 2 , ..., a n ) = x and . As this number could be large, print the answer modulo 10 9 + 7 . gcd here means the greatest common divisor .
input_specification: The only line contains two positive integers x and y ( 1 ≤ x , y ≤ 10 9 ).
output_specification: Print the number of such sequences modulo 10 9 + 7 .
approach_summary: Define state dp[mask][i] capturing the subset of visited/chosen elements. Transition by iterating over valid unset bits in O(2^N × N) time.
